seeded_failure.symptom: Running the compiled class from terminal displays 'Error: Could not find or load main class Receipt'.
seeded_failure.cause: The java command was executed from inside the package directory specifying only the simple class name instead of from source root using fully qualified package name.
seeded_failure.fix: Navigate to the src root folder and execute 'java com.example.receipt.Receipt'.

seeded_failure.symptom: The unit converter returns 0.0 for temperature conversions like 100 Celsius to Fahrenheit.
seeded_failure.cause: The conversion formula uses integer division (5 / 9) which evaluates to 0 before multiplying the temperature input.
seeded_failure.fix: Change integer literals in the conversion fraction to floating-point numbers like (5.0 / 9.0).
